title: AI travel itinerary planner
summary: Describe your trip; get a full itinerary instantly.
whyTempting: Trip planning takes hours; AI can do it fast.
whyItFails: Revenue leaks. Bookings happen elsewhere. Low frequency. Users travel occasionally. Free general chatbots. General AI assistants do this well.
whatWouldChange: Agents that can actually book and manage changes end-to-end.

attempts.outcome: Ceased operations; acquired by Capital One
attempts.notes: AI travel assistant from Kayak co-founder Paul English. Pivoted to business travel before closing.
Auto-built itineraries from your bookings; Google closed the app in 2019.

reasons.detail: Free general chatbots: General AI assistants do this well.
